WITH claimed_properties AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    pcd.Insurable_Object_Identifier
  FROM "acme_insurance"."main"."claim_coverage" AS cc
  JOIN "acme_insurance"."main"."policy_coverage_detail" AS pcd
    ON cc.Effective_Date = pcd.Effective_Date
   AND cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
),
losses AS (
  SELECT
    pcd.Insurable_Object_Identifier,
    SUM(CASE WHEN lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END) AS loss_payments,
    SUM(CASE WHEN lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier IS NOT NULL THEN ca.Claim_Amount ELSE 0 END) AS loss_reserves
  FROM "acme_insurance"."main"."claim_amount" AS ca
  JOIN "acme_insurance"."main"."claim_coverage" AS cc
    ON ca.Claim_Identifier = cc.Claim_Identifier
  JOIN "acme_insurance"."main"."policy_coverage_detail" AS pcd
    ON cc.Effective_Date = pcd.Effective_Date
   AND cc.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
  LEFT JOIN "acme_insurance"."main"."loss_payment" AS lp
    ON ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier = lp.Claim_Amount_Identifier
  LEFT JOIN "acme_insurance"."main"."loss_reserve" AS lr
    ON ca.Claim_Amount_Identifier = lr.Claim_Amount_Identifier
  GROUP BY pcd.Insurable_Object_Identifier
),
premiums AS (
  SELECT
    pcd.Insurable_Object_Identifier,
    SUM(pa.Policy_Amount) AS premium_charged
  FROM "acme_insurance"."main"."premium" AS pr
  JOIN "acme_insurance"."main"."policy_amount" AS pa
    ON pr.Policy_Amount_Identifier = pa.Policy_Amount_Identifier
  JOIN "acme_insurance"."main"."policy_coverage_detail" AS pcd
    ON pa.Effective_Date = pcd.Effective_Date
   AND pa.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier = pcd.Policy_Coverage_Detail_Identifier
  GROUP BY pcd.Insurable_Object_Identifier
)
SELECT
  cp.Insurable_Object_Identifier,
  la.Line_1_Address,
  (COALESCE(l.loss_payments, 0) + COALESCE(l.loss_reserves, 0)) / NULLIF(p.premium_charged, 0) AS incurred_loss_to_premium_ratio,
  RANK() OVER (
    ORDER BY (COALESCE(l.loss_payments, 0) + COALESCE(l.loss_reserves, 0)) / NULLIF(p.premium_charged, 0) DESC
  ) AS property_rank
FROM claimed_properties AS cp
JOIN "acme_insurance"."main"."insurable_object" AS io
  ON cp.Insurable_Object_Identifier = io.Insurable_Object_Identifier
JOIN "acme_insurance"."main"."geographic_location" AS gl
  ON io.Geographic_Location_Identifier = gl.Geographic_Location_Identifier
JOIN "acme_insurance"."main"."location_address" AS la
  ON gl.Location_Address_Identifier = la.Location_Address_Identifier
LEFT JOIN losses AS l
  ON cp.Insurable_Object_Identifier = l.Insurable_Object_Identifier
LEFT JOIN premiums AS p
  ON cp.Insurable_Object_Identifier = p.Insurable_Object_Identifier
ORDER BY incurred_loss_to_premium_ratio DESC
LIMIT 500
